summary: Makes TimestampUtils.toTimestamp(Calendar, byte[]) reject empty text with a PSQLException (SQLState 22007) instead of ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, with two unit tests.

tests.evidence: Bug fix mandates tests; the two added tests cover only toTimestamp, while the description claims a rejectsEmptyInput test over every entry point (toDate, toLocalDate, toLocalDateTime, toOffsetDateTime, toOffsetTime, toTime, toLocalTime) that does not exist in the diff.

user_docs.evidence: Internal parsing bug fix; no option, property, or documented behavior changes.

doc_comments.evidence: Private guard inside an existing method; no public contract or comment changed.

change_description.evidence: The PR body describes a shared checkNotEmpty helper applied to six methods and a rejectsEmptyInput test, but the commit adds an inline check only in toTimestamp; the commit message itself says date and time were already clean, contradicting the body. No changelog entry for a user-visible fix.

performance.evidence: One length check before an existing branch; negligible on the decode path.

security.evidence: Not a security surface; values come from the server's text encoding.

backward_compat.evidence: Exception type changes from ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException to PSQLException; the description notes it, and it moves toward the JDBC contract.

concurrency.evidence: Guard sits inside the existing lock; no lifecycle change.

error_model.evidence: Adds a new error path: reuses 'Bad value for type timestamp/date/time' with SQLState 22007 and an empty {0}; worth checking it matches how other malformed values are reported.

correctness.evidence: Fix is incomplete: at base 23a1b0dac5 toLocalDateTime(byte[]) (line 587), toOffsetDateTime (652), toDate (762), toLocalDate (809) still read bytes[0] unguarded, and toOffsetTime(byte[]) (550) indexes bytes[0..7] so any input shorter than 8 bytes throws AIOOBE; the PR leaves all of them.

user_value.evidence: Plain bug fix, no new API.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Same getter now throws different exceptions depending on target type (SQLException for Timestamp, AIOOBE still for LocalDateTime/OffsetDateTime/Date).

contradictions.evidence: Description claims six methods and a shared helper fixed; code fixes one; the siblings in the same class still disagree on empty input.

observability.evidence: Exception propagates to caller; no logging decision.

spec_conformance.evidence: JDBC getters should throw SQLException, which the fix moves toward; no spec section in dispute.

plan.why: A six-line fix in one class; one reviewer comparing the description with the code and sibling methods covers every required axis.
